facts.business: Zee Learn Limited is a leading education company operating across early childhood (Kidzee preschools), K-12 schooling (Mount Litera Zee Schools), international education (Mount Litera School International), and creative arts/skill development (ZIMA, ZICA).

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to possible effects of matters described in 'Basis for qualified opinion' section, including corporate guarantee invocation by Yes Bank Limited, CIRP proceedings, and settlement agreement termination with J.C. Flowers Asset Reconstructions Private Limited.

key_risks: Corporate guarantee obligations and litigation with Yes Bank Limited / J.C. Flowers Asset Reconstructions Private Limited
Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) proceedings risk
Settlement agreement termination and ongoing financial obligations
Dependence on franchise model for preschool and school network
facts.related_party_note: Corporate guarantees issued by the Company and its subsidiary Digital Ventures Private Limited (DVPL) for credit facilities availed by four trusts/entities; settlement agreement with J.C. Flowers for Rs 28,500 lakhs; transactions with related parties including trusts/entities.
